title: Detecting Data Contamination from Reinforcement Learning Post-training for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Yongding Tao, Tian Wang, Yihong Dong, Huanyu Liu, Kechi Zhang, Xiaolong Hu, Ge Li
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器失效或奖励投机审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计基准污染、评估偏差或奖励投机风险的研究者。
one_line: RL-MIA benchmark and post-training contamination detector
Self-Critique以初始与批评回复的熵轨迹相似度检测 RL 后训练数据污染。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benchmark items can leak into RL post-training and inflate reported reasoning capability. Likelihood-based contamination detectors target pre-training or SFT objectives and can fail after reward optimization.

The paper formulates RL-stage membership inference in a black-box setting and introduces Self-Critique plus RL-MIA, a controlled benchmark for this contamination mode.

benchmark 样本会泄入 RL 后训练并虚高推理能力；面向预训练或 SFT 目标的似然检测器在奖励优化之后可能失效。

论文在黑箱条件下形式化 RL 阶段成员推断，提出 Self-Critique 与用于模拟此类污染的 RL-MIA 评测基准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Self-Critique detects RL contamination by eliciting an initial answer and a critique-conditioned alternative, then comparing their token-level entropy trajectories. High similarity is treated as evidence of RL-induced policy collapse on a seen item.

RL-MIA supplies the evaluation surface. The key contribution is an active, entropy-based black-box signal rather than a new RL training method.

Self-Critique 先诱导初始回答和以其为条件的批评式替代回答，再比较两者 token-level entropy 轨迹；高相似度被视为已见样本上 RL 诱发 policy collapse 的证据。

RL-MIA 是评测面。真正贡献是主动式、基于熵的黑箱检测信号，而不是新的 RL 训练方法。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. For a candidate item, query the RL-post-trained model for its most confident initial reasoning response.
  2. Prompt it to critique or produce a different solution conditioned on that response; collect token-level entropy from both generations.
  3. Compare entropy sequences. Similar trajectories indicate narrow path dependence and are classified as membership; evaluate against RL-MIA and baselines.

Fix model API/logprob availability, prompts, decoding, contamination construction and threshold. The method is black-box only insofar as token probabilities/entropy can be obtained.

1. 对候选样本查询 RL 后训练模型，取得最有把握的初始推理回复。
  2. 以该回复为条件，要求模型批评或给出不同解法，收集两次生成的 token-level entropy。
  3. 比较熵序列；相似轨迹表示狭窄路径依赖并被判为成员，再在 RL-MIA 与基线上评测。

应固定 API/logprob 可得性、提示词、解码、污染构造和阈值；只有能取得 token 概率/熵时，该方法才是可执行的黑箱检测。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On RL-MIA and multiple models/tasks, Self-Critique substantially outperforms likelihood-style baselines that are near random for RL contamination. The paper reports up to 30 AUC points average improvement and up to 55 points in dual-contamination settings.

These results support detection in the constructed RL setting, not a guarantee for every proprietary API or unobserved post-training recipe.

在 RL-MIA、多模型和多污染任务上，Self-Critique 显著优于对 RL 污染近似随机的似然式基线。论文报告平均 AUC 最多提高 30 点，在双重污染设置中最多提高 55 点。

这支持构造的 RL 设置中的检测有效性，不能保证适用于所有闭源 API 或未公开的后训练配方。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier detectors use likelihood or perplexity because MLE training raises probability on seen strings. This work changes the signal and probing protocol for reward-trained policies: it tests entropy-path dependence after self-critique.

Membership inference is not new; RL-specific policy-collapse probing and RL-MIA are the change. Verify required logprob access before reuse.

早期 detector 依赖似然或 perplexity，因为 MLE 会抬高已见字符串的概率。本文针对奖励训练策略改变信号与 probing：在 self-critique 后检验熵路径依赖。

成员推断并不新；RL 专属的 policy-collapse probing 与 RL-MIA 才是变化。复用前须确认能访问 logprob。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The detector assumes contaminated RL examples create stable narrow entropy paths and that the service exposes reliable token probabilities. Different decoding policies, unavailable logprobs, or adaptive training could weaken the signal.

RL-MIA simulates contamination; audit transfer to the actual training pipeline before making a public contamination claim.

该 detector 假设受污染 RL 样本会形成稳定而狭窄的熵路径，且服务能暴露可靠 token probability。不同解码策略、缺少 logprob 或适应性训练都可能削弱信号。

RL-MIA 是模拟污染；在公开指控真实训练管线污染前，必须审计其迁移性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use it to audit a reasoning model after RL when you have candidate benchmark items and token-logprob access. Run initial and critique prompts, score entropy similarity, and report detector AUC alongside a clean/control set.

Do not use it as proof of leakage without validating the threshold against the actual model and training recipe.

若有候选 benchmark 样本和 token-logprob 访问权限，可用它审计 RL 后的推理模型：运行初始/批评提示，评分熵相似度，并与干净对照集一起报告 detector AUC。

未在真实模型和训练配方上校准阈值前，不能把结果当作泄漏的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: RL post-training needs a detector beyond likelihood-based contamination tests.
  • Lever: compare initial and self-critique token entropy trajectories for policy collapse.
  • Artifact: RL-MIA models the relevant membership-inference setting; code is released officially.
  • Evidence: up to 30 AUC points average and 55 points dual-contamination improvement are reported.
  • Decision: require logprobs and calibrate on pipeline-matched controls before claiming contamination.

• 定位：RL 后训练需要超越似然式污染测试的 detector。
  • 抓手：比较初始与 self-critique 的 token entropy 轨迹以识别 policy collapse。
  • Artifact：RL-MIA 模拟对应成员推断设置，官方发布代码。
  • 证据：论文报告平均最多提升 30 AUC 点、双重污染最多提升 55 点。
  • 决策：必须有 logprob，并在管线匹配的对照上校准后再声称污染。
